_about: Fight song videos (Matthew, Nov 16 2026): each school's anchor performs its fight song, filed under Multimedia on the team page. Only public-domain songs are performed (US: published before 1931 as of 2026), always as our own new performance, never a commercial or band recording. plan: perform = full song; 'alma mater instead' = the fight song is copyrighted but an old alma mater is free; story = anchor tells the song's history without singing or quoting it. A row shows on the team page only once it has a youtube id (fields: youtube, performer, credit).

ohio.title: Stand Up and Cheer
ohio.note: Written for Kansas in 1909; Ohio adapted the words (school-name swap).
ohio.credit: Hardwood Bricks Spirit, episode one: Ohio's 1909 fight song, then Whitey Ruiz on the man who wrote it.

miami-oh.title: Love and Honor (Miami Fight Song)
miami-oh.writers: Tune by Raymond Burke for the Men's Glee Club; lyricist not stated
miami-oh.note: Premiered Feb 28, 1908; sheet music dated 1928. Both before 1931.

umass.title: Fight Mass
umass.note: Written spring 1930. Need proof it was published (songbook, sheet music) in 1930. Do not use Gerald Bilik's later band arrangement.

akron.title: The Akron Blue and Gold
akron.alt: Alma mater 'Close beside Cuyahoga's waters' (words Rev. Augustus B. Church, 1909, to 'Annie Lisle', 1857): public domain.

buffalo.title: Victory March / Buffalo Fight Song
buffalo.writers: Robert Mols (1956, words rewritten 2000); Meredith Willson (1960)
buffalo.alt: Alma Mater (1903, words Samuel B. Botsford, music Walter S. Goodale): public domain.

kent-state.title: Fight On for K.S.U.
kent-state.alt: Alma mater (E. Turner Stump / Dwight Steere) first published 1931: public domain Jan 1, 2027.

toledo.title: U of Toledo
toledo.writers: Dave Connelly, music set by Bernie Jones; 1975 arr. David Jex

western-michigan.title: WMU Fight Song
western-michigan.alt: 1921 'Western's Fight Song' ('Hail, Hail for Western Normal School'): author and text not found yet; would be public domain.
